headline: CSU Pueblo stay unbeaten with a twelfth win
dek: CSU Pueblo went to Colorado Christian and came away with a twelfth win; they have drawn twice and are yet to lose. Their next match is at home to Colorado School of Mines.
displaced_by: results night: CSU Pueblo's win at Colorado Christian keeps their unbeaten season going
